summary: ITERATION 6 BLOCKER RESOLVED. The fix (HTTP 502→424 + code-based client detection) works end-to-end across BOTH localhost:8001 AND the public Cloudflare/K8s ingress (https://safety-check-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com). 12/12 pytest tests PASS. Verified via direct curl and parametric tests: POST /api/assessments and POST /api/assessments/{aid}/resync return HTTP 424 with Content-Type: application/json and body literally containing 'AUTHORITATIVE_UPSTREAM_ERROR' from BOTH origins — the ingress no longer rewrites the response. Full envelope preserved end-to-end: {detail:{code:'AUTHORITATIVE_UPSTREAM_ERROR', message:<Spanish>, upstream_url:'https://pulso-activo--cailus84.replit.app/api/assessments', upstream_status:401, upstream_body:'{"message":"Unauthorized"}'}}. Ghost-record guard verified via localhost pre/post GET (count unchanged via both origins). Resync path leaves DB record untouched (calc_source=pending, zone/pattern=null, calc_notice unchanged). Secondary paths unchanged: (a) empty token → 200 pending + Spanish notice, (b) unreachable URL → 200 pending + 'Sin red al servidor autoritativo' suffix, (c) GET /api/ reports upstream_configured=true and calc_source_default=authoritative. Static audit confirms: server.py contains two `status_code=424` sites (create + resync), zero zone thresholds, no calc_assessment, no BLUE/GREEN/YELLOW/RED literals; api.ts uses status-agnostic gate `detail.code === 'AUTHORITATIVE_UPSTREAM_ERROR'` (also accepts detail.upstream_status+upstream_body as fallback) and no longer has `res.status === 502` in the code path. Math-only calc (FCP, HRR, RECpct, AURC, tau) still faithful. retest_needed=false.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_afetm_ingress_424.py. It MUST run serially with `-n 0` because tests mutate /app/backend/.env and restart supervisor (pytest.ini defaults to -n 2 loadscope which causes parallel worker races on the shared .env). Run with: `EXPO_BACKEND_URL=https://safety-check-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_afetm_ingress_424.py -v -n 0`. If the ingress ever regresses (e.g., starts rewriting 424 too), the parametric public_ingress tests will fail first with an assertion about Content-Type / literal 'AUTHORITATIVE_UPSTREAM_ERROR' missing from body. Iteration 6's blocker test file /app/backend/tests/test_afetm_strict_upstream.py is now OBSOLETE (asserts 502) — can be deleted or updated by main agent.
rca_of_issue: RESOLVED. Root cause was Cloudflare/K8s ingress silently substituting the origin's HTTP 502 application/json response with its own HTML 502 'Bad gateway' page. FIX: server.py now raises 424 Failed Dependency (semantically correct: request failed because a dependency failed) which the ingress does NOT intercept. VERIFIED with curl: `curl -X POST https://safety-check-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com/api/assessments ...` → 424 application/json with the exact JSON envelope including the literal string 'AUTHORITATIVE_UPSTREAM_ERROR'. Client-side robustness: api.ts req() no longer gates on HTTP status — it inspects `detail.code` (with envelope-shape fallback), so any future status swap remains transparent to the mobile app.
